message:
I recently went through a little power outage at home and it turned out to be a surprisingly cozy experience! I had prepped a few essentials ahead of time, like flashlights and snacks, which made all the difference. It felt good to be ready and not scramble in the dark. 

I've found that having a plan can turn a potential hassle into a small win. If you're curious about how to prepare for those unexpected moments, I came across a helpful resource that covers the basics really well. 

What’s your best tip for staying calm and collected during a blackout? 💡
